answer.summary: One of 1486 tests failed: XtmHubNewsFeedSyncIntegrationTest.given_featureFlagOff_should_notCallHub. Mockito says the Hub client was called when the feature flag was off, via XtmHubService.consumeAndCreateNewsFeedItems with a 'first-token' argument. That looks like state leaking from earlier tests (a tenant token from another test), not from the change, which only bumps the opensearch-client pom. Other errors in the log (engine down, NPE on platform settings, ES mapping conflict) are not clearly tied to this test. The log does not prove the cause, so confidence is moderate; a re-run should settle it.

evidence.quote: XTM Hub rejected the registration token of every registered tenant
